manifest.name: Building Permit (Example)
manifest.description: Read-only demo of a municipal permit process.

Rejected"><bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming></bpmn:endEvent>

dmnXml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" xmlns:dmndi="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/DMNDI/" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20180521/DC/" id="definitions" name="Permit Eligibility" namespace="http://algomation.io/dmn">
  <decision id="Decision_main" name="Permit Eligibility">
    <decisionTable id="dt_1" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="In_zone" label="Zoning Type"><inputExpression id="IE_zone" typeRef="string"><text>zoningType</text></inputExpression></input>
      <input id="In_size" label="Floor Area m2"><inputExpression id="IE_size" typeRef="number"><text>floorArea</text></inputExpression></input>
      <output id="Out_result" label="Decision" name="eligibility" typeRef="string"/>
      <output id="Out_fee" label="Fee EUR" name="fee" typeRef="number"/>
      <rule id="R1"><inputEntry id="R1i1"><text>"residential"</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="R1i2"><text><= 150</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="R1o1"><text>"Approved"</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="R1o2"><text>150</text></outputEntry></rule>
      <rule id="R2"><inputEntry id="R2i1"><text>"residential"</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="R2i2"><text>> 150</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="R2o1"><text>"Review Required"</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="R2o2"><text>300</text></outputEntry></rule>
      <rule id="R3"><inputEntry id="R3i1"><text>"commercial"</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="R3i2"><text><= 500</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="R3o1"><text>"Approved"</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="R3o2"><text>500</text></outputEntry></rule>
      <rule id="R4"><inputEntry id="R4i1"><text>"commercial"</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="R4i2"><text>> 500</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="R4o1"><text>"Review Required"</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="R4o2"><text>1000</text></outputEntry></rule>
      <rule id="R5"><inputEntry id="R5i1"><text>"industrial"</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="R5i2"><text>-</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="R5o1"><text>"Special Approval"</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="R5o2"><text>2000</text></outputEntry></rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>
cmmnXml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/CMMN/20151109/MODEL" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://algomation.io/cmmn">
  <case id="Case_main" name="Building Permit Case">
    <casePlanModel id="CasePlanModel_1" name="Permit Review Plan" autoComplete="false">
      <planItem id="PI_S1" definitionRef="Stage_Docs"/>
      <planItem id="PI_S2" definitionRef="Stage_Tech"/>
      <stage id="Stage_Docs" name="Documentation">
        <planItem id="PI_T1" definitionRef="HT_1"/>
        <planItem id="PI_T2" definitionRef="HT_2"/>
        <humanTask id="HT_1" name="Upload Documents"/>
        <humanTask id="HT_2" name="Verify Ownership"/>
      </stage>
      <stage id="Stage_Tech" name="Technical Assessment">
        <planItem id="PI_T3" definitionRef="HT_3"/>
        <planItem id="PI_T4" definitionRef="HT_4"/>
        <humanTask id="HT_3" name="Site Inspection"/>
        <humanTask id="HT_4" name="Structural Review"/>
      </stage>
    </casePlanModel>
  </case>
</definitions>
